posts.name: Kishore Kumar S
posts.cooked:
In the previous term, I attempted Programming in Python course, but I missed both of the OPPEs, due to which I got an I_OP grade. I have reregistered for the OPPE alone, but my Graded Assignment progress is missing in my dashboard.
Should I reattempt all the Graded Assignments, and if I do reattempt, which marks will be counted?
Also, do I need to attempt the in-person quizzes too? (Quiz 1, End Term exam)

Thanks in advance.

posts.name: Anupam
posts.cooked: As you attempted as a New Course in Previous Term then there is no need to do GA and Quiz and ET You have to Only Give OPPE Exam, Rest Score will carry forward by the Team.

posts.name: BHAVEN
posts.cooked:
There is no need to give all the GAs/ GRPAs again as there marks would be carried forward if you have registered for “Repeat Only OPPE”. You can refer to the below criteria mentioned in the grading document.
